# Panoramica Solutions

> RevOps implementation for early-stage teams. AI-enabled systems built inside your stack, each with a defined scope and a clear price.

Panoramica Solutions is run by Lorenzo Liviero, a RevOps operator. Client names stay private.

## Services

- [Email outreach infrastructure](https://www.panoramica.solutions/email-outreach): A model writes each email from what your database knows about the contact, and sends it from domains and accounts you own. Custom scope.
- [Data foundation](https://www.panoramica.solutions/database): We define who you sell to, then source, enrich, verify, deduplicate and score the companies and contacts, and load them into your CRM. Custom scope.
- [Goldmine](https://www.panoramica.solutions/goldmine): Goldmine cross-references your CRM history, calls, emails and notes on every lead, adds outside research, and delivers a ranked queue every day. £6,000 / £8,500 / £11,000.
- [The Brief](https://www.panoramica.solutions/the-brief): A brief lands in Gmail before every external meeting: the facts, a behavioral profile of the person, and advice for the call. £1,000 fixed setup.
- [Revenue Architect](https://www.panoramica.solutions/revenue-architect): A guided diagnostic that argues with your first answer, then hands you an action plan. £149 self-serve.
- [Marketing Studio](https://www.panoramica.solutions/the-studio): Social images, carousels, PDFs, one-pagers, landing pages and emails, planned as a campaign and held for your approval. £7,500 fixed build.

## Articles

- [Research agents: the bridge between your CRM and what's happening](https://www.panoramica.solutions/research-agents-bridge): Your CRM knows what happened. It has no idea what is happening right now at the account. Research agents close that gap, if you build the bridge correctly.
- [CRM intelligence: the missing layer between pipeline and closure](https://www.panoramica.solutions/crm-intelligence-pipeline-closure): Most CRMs store history, and few tell reps what to do next. This piece covers what CRM intelligence requires and why so many pipeline reviews turn into data archaeology.
- [Build vs configure: why some revenue problems need custom software](https://www.panoramica.solutions/build-vs-configure-custom-software): Every RevOps stack eventually hits a wall that no amount of configuration can fix. This piece covers how to tell when the answer is custom software instead of another integration.
- [Change doesn't scale: managing RevOps transformation at every stage of growth](https://www.panoramica.solutions/change-management-organisation-size): Change management fails differently at startups, scale-ups and enterprises. Tactics that work at 20 people can damage trust at 200. This piece covers how to read the room.
- [Lifecycle logic: the framework your customer journey is missing](https://www.panoramica.solutions/lifecycle-logic-customer-journey): Most customer journey maps are funnels redrawn. Lifecycle logic starts from the customer's perspective, which changes how you run revenue.
- [The death of the funnel: why flywheels win](https://www.panoramica.solutions/revops-strategy-2026): Funnels miss the compounding value of customer retention. This piece covers how to build a revenue flywheel.
- [HubSpot vs Salesforce: the 2026 verdict](https://www.panoramica.solutions/hubspot-vs-salesforce): Choosing a CRM is an expensive decision. We compare the pros and cons for scaling SaaS teams.
